local_calculation.derivation: At p=2, the finite-index open subgroup is free Z2 of rank [K_w:Q2], so completion is a finitely generated Z2 module of that rank plus finite torsion. At odd p, the open subgroup is pro-p, multiplication by2 is an automorphism, and its two-adic completion vanishes; the completion of the whole group is its finite two-primary quotient. The finite torsion has two cyclic factors because its subgroup killed by2 is the rational elliptic E[2], of dimension2. The derived Kummer complex retains this finite torsion contribution in degree0 and adds it to the free rank in degree1 under reduction.
